content: No controls page. The interact primitive's button is likely a mouse button name like "primary"/"secondary" or a key. I'll try "primary" on a single tile first, and use raw_input as a fallback isn't possible without knowing keys. Let me test "primary" and "secondary" on separate targets so one of them reveals the valid id.

args.approach: "left" and "use" both rejected; probe the remaining likely button ids — "primary" on the notice board, then "secondary" on a soil tile — so the small brain reports which id the game accepts before committing to the full farm loop.
